nvidia.name: NVIDIA trial access
nvidia.summary: AI chat uses NVIDIA hosted models through a key you create.
nvidia.step: Sign in at build.nvidia.com, create an API key, and paste it into the setup page on your computer. Skip this to stay offline; everything except AI chat still works.

openai.name: your OpenAI API account
openai.summary: AI chat uses your OpenAI API account and its usage billing.
openai.step: In your OpenAI API account, create a key and set a monthly spend limit there. Paste the key into the setup page on your computer.

anthropic.name: your Anthropic API account
anthropic.summary: AI chat uses your Anthropic API account and its usage billing.
anthropic.step: In the Claude Console, create an API key and set a spend limit there. Paste the key into the setup page on your computer.

ollama.name: Ollama on your computer
ollama.summary: AI chat runs on your own computer with Ollama, no key needed.
ollama.step: Install Ollama separately, run ollama pull gemma3:4b, and keep Ollama running for local chat.

camera.name: Presence lock
camera.note: The presence lock uses your webcam to ask Windows to lock when you leave. Keep Windows auto-lock on as well.
camera.step: Choose Install selected tools to download the camera pieces. The camera stays off.

hand.name: Hand control
hand.note: Hand control needs a webcam and a one-time hand tracking download. Accuracy depends on your camera and lighting.
hand.step: Choose Install selected tools to download hand tracking. The camera and pointer stay off.

notes.nvidia_trial: NVIDIA offers no-cost API access for trial and evaluation. Rate limits, queues and eligibility vary and can change, so replies may wait at busy times. Check NVIDIA's current terms.
notes.offline_core: With no key at all, Jarvis still runs its core offline: dashboard, hand control and presence lock. Only AI chat needs a provider.
notes.start_small: Your budget leaves room for a paid API later. Start with trial access and switch only if its limits get in your way.
notes.nvidia_paid: Trial access is meant for evaluation. Ongoing or heavier use may need NVIDIA's paid terms; check them before relying on it.
notes.openai_zero: OpenAI API requests need available API credits or billing on your API account, and a $0 plan cannot count on future usage being covered. NVIDIA trial access or Ollama are suggested instead.
notes.anthropic_zero: Anthropic API requests need available API credits or billing on your Console account, and a $0 plan cannot count on future usage being covered. NVIDIA trial access or Ollama are suggested instead.
notes.chat_subscription: A ChatGPT or Claude chat subscription is separate from API access. Some plans may include eligible API credits; check your account instead of assuming they do.
notes.ollama_option: Ollama runs models on your own computer with no usage bill. Choose Ollama above if you already have it.
notes.ollama_hardware: Ollama speed depends on your hardware. A recent graphics card can feel quick; a laptop without one runs small models on its processor and RAM, so expect slower replies from larger models.
notes.paid_usage: The provider bills each request. Set a spend limit in your provider account, because Jarvis does not enforce one.

budget_note: Your monthly budget is a planning preference, not a billing limit. Prices are set by each provider and can change.

steps.download: Download the Jarvis Windows package and unzip it into a folder you own.
steps.start: Open Start-Jarvis-Windows.cmd in the unzipped folder (Start-Jarvis.cmd if you use the source ZIP). Setup opens in your browser, on your own computer.
steps.dashboard: Choose Open dashboard. Camera, mouse control and Windows lock stay off until you switch each one on.
steps.practice: Practice the four hand moves before you let hand control move the real pointer.
